verdict.rationale: Ironclad publishes an extensive public REST API with first-party documentation. It covers Records and Workflows APIs for creating, retrieving and interacting with data, workflow launch and bulk launch, data exports, OAuth 2.0 client credentials auth, and webhook management, with machine-friendly llms.txt and markdown docs confirmed by probe. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at standard paths, API access is gated behind a paid add-on, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Ironclad's rich API can be used to connect your contract data and contracting process to your applications and internal platforms.
The corresponding Workflows API allows you to retrieve, create, and interact with active and completed workflows.
The corresponding Records API allows you to retrieve, update, and create records.
This is a simple example outlining how to launch a workflow using our REST API.
Integrations can also directly control the contract process, automatically blocking or pushing forward approvals.
Ironclad primarily uses the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework to generate API bearer tokens that can be used to authenticate API requests.
